question: Where can I get the locations or boundaries of protected cultural heritage and archaeological sites in Spain, with protection category and the authority that holds the register?

answer.summary: No single national dataset of protected heritage geometry was found. The national register (Ministerio de Cultura, RBIC) is a search form with category, code and dates but no coordinates. Registers are regional: 13 regions or cities publish geometry (polygons in Andalucía, Aragón, Asturias, Cantabria, Castilla y León, Castilla-La Mancha, Cataluña, Galicia, Madrid city, Murcia, Navarra, Valencia, País Vasco; Canarias view only). IGN has 1,245 BIC points without category.
main_caveats: Geometry exists only regionally: formats, CRS (EPSG:25829, 25830, 25831, 32628, 4326), categories and scope (BIC vs local interest vs catalogued/inventoried) all differ and must be harmonised.
The Ministry database is marked "en revisión", is a per-record web form (no download) and does not contain BIC declared by law (castles, rock art, hórreos, crosses).
Several layers mix legal levels: Murcia 3,428 catalogados vs 1,985 BIC; Cataluña BCIL 14,406 vs BCIN 2,161; Cantabria includes BIL and inventariados; Andalucía 207 of 2,425 are catalogación general.

Gaps: Baleares, Ceuta and Melilla have no geometry service; La Rioja portals block automated clients; Canarias and País Vasco give view services or point layers; Madrid polygons cover Madrid city only.
Cataluña WFS rejected curl default identification (403) and answered via WebFetch; Aragón server was very slow; opendata.jcyl.es zip has a broken SSL chain.
answer.confidence_reason: Live services tested in 14 regions and the national forms; negatives (Baleares, La Rioja, Ceuta, Melilla) rest on opened catalogues and pages, La Rioja only through an archived copy.

attributes.note: IGN 1,245 BIC points; Wikidata 12,679 coordinates linked to the BIC code; no national official complete point list.
attributes.gap_note: MCU register has no coordinates; IGN layer is a tourist-oriented subset (name only). Queried: MCU form, IGN REST, Wikidata.

attributes.note: Polygons from 13 regions (WFS, REST, OGC API, GeoJSON, shapefile); Canarias WMS only; no national layer; Baleares, La Rioja, Ceuta, Melilla none.
attributes.gap_note: No national polygon layer in IDEE CSW, datos.gob.es, MCU or IGN. No geometry found for Baleares (IDEIB, CKAN, Consell pages), La Rioja (portal blocks automated clients; archived OGC list has no heritage layer), Ceuta and Melilla (HTML pages, PDF catalogue).

attributes.note: MCU gives categoría per record nationally; regional layers carry category fields with different vocabularies.
attributes.gap_note: MCU database is under review, has no bulk download and omits BIC declared by law (castles, rock art, hórreos...).

attributes.note: MCU keeps the register for state-level BIC; each autonomous community keeps the rest and reports to it (RD 111/1986 art. 21).

steps: Pick the region of the asset (the register authority is the autonomous community; Ceuta and Melilla are city administrations).

ArcGIS REST regions (Galicia, País Vasco, Castilla-La Mancha, Madrid city): append /query with where=1=1, returnCountOnly=true or outFields=*, outSR=4326, f=json (or f=geojson); layer ids are in the MapServer?f=pjson listing.
WFS regions: read GetCapabilities, request typeNames with outputFormat=application/json, paginate with count/startIndex; use resultType=hits for counts. Endpoints are in members.
Cataluña: layers PATRIMONI_BCIN_ARQUITEC, PATRIMONI_BCIN_ARQUEOPALEO (state-declared and national-interest), PATRIMONI_BCIL_* (local interest); use CRS EPSG:25831 or request srsName.
Cantabria: OGC API collections/{0,2,3,5,6}/items?f=geojson&limit=5000; filter TIPO = "Bien de Interés Cultural" to drop BIL and inventariados.
Aragón and Navarra: download the file and reproject (UTM 30N, EPSG:25830) to WGS84 before mixing with other regions.

Harmonise: keep an own column for legal level (BIC / local / inventoried) and map each region category vocabulary to one list; join to the ministry record by code where it exists (Galicia ID_RAGE, Wikidata P808).
reading_traps: CRS differs by region: EPSG:25830 (AN, AR, CL, CM, MD, MU, NA, VA), EPSG:25831 (Cataluña), EPSG:25829 (Galicia IDEG), EPSG:32628 (Canarias WMS), EPSG:4326 (Asturias WFS, Cantabria, Tenerife); the Aragón GeoJSON has no crs member although coordinates are UTM metres (ogr assumes WGS84); the Galicia ODS and Extremadura XLSX have no declared CRS.

Legal level is mixed: Cataluña BCIL 14,406 (local) vs BCIN 2,161; Andalucía 207 of 2,425 are catalogación general; Cantabria collection 0 has 160 inventariados and 57 BIL; Aragón clase = B.I.C. 631, Catalogado 256, Inventariado 18; Castilla y León yac_arqu_vw has 23,624 polygons of which only 107 are ZONA ARQUEOLÓGICA.
Category text is messy: Aragón categoria has Monumento 416, MONUMENTO 57, Zona arqueológica 52 vs ZONA ARQUEOLOGICA 11, and 265 empty values; Navarra shapefiles have no category field.
Valencia BIC.Delimitaciones has only 32 polygons and BIC has 0 features: absence of a polygon does not mean the asset is not BIC.

Galicia: the IDEG layers belong to the Plan Básico Autonómico (planning) and mix BIC (layers 2-10) with Catálogo (80,010 points); the ODS list has 461 of 785 rows as Xenérica (BIC by law), 135 rows without coordinates, X and Y as text without a declared CRS.
Points are not boundaries: Cantabria collection 0, Navarra architecture, Galicia layer 2 and the ODS are points.
Cataluña answers 403 to curl default identification and the Aragón server needed minutes for 3.5 MB.

Murcia patrimonio_cultura_cbi has 3,428 CATALOGADO and 1,985 BIC rows, and entorno and parts are separate rows (Elemento_Protegido PRINCIPAL 1,085, PARTE DE BIC 564, ENTORNO 337); Castilla-La Mancha layer 1 includes "Genérico" BIC (castles by law); Madrid covers the city only.
Asturias: three layers (Puntos 336, Áreas 234, Entornos 236) are separate; País Vasco REST layers have no category column, only a record page URL (BIECODIGO).

steps: Search by name, locality, municipality, province or community; each result links to a detail page.
Parse the HTML; there is no export or API, so iterate by community or province and respect the site.
Use the code as join key with regional layers and Wikidata P808.
reading_traps: The page says the database is under review and recommends regional catalogues for newer data.
Castles, rock art, hórreos and other BIC by law are absent.
Names are not unique (7 results for "Alhambra", including Ciudad Real).
The code prefix R.I. / A.R.I. shows legal status; the ministry code of Wikidata P808 drops the last block (RI-51-0010903).

recipe: Find the declaration in the regional layer or the ministry record (gazette reference in documento, publicacio, DOG or PUB_WEB fields) and open the BOE or regional gazette PDF.
Extract text with pdftotext -layout (tested on BOE-A-2009-425, 4 pages, text layer present).
Read the annex: a) denominación, b) localización with cadastral references, c) description, d) "Delimitación del entorno" with UTM coordinates in the order A, B, C...

Build the polygon from the listed vertices in order (5 vertices in the example); the coordinate reference system (UTM zone, datum) is not stated in the text, so infer from the territory and check against the cadastre or orthophoto.
The plano adjunto is an image page without text (page 3 of the PDF): convert with pdftoppm -png -r 80 and georeference by eye if coordinates are missing.

Asturias decrees (BOPA) define the protection area by cadastral parcels, not coordinates: list the parcels from Anexo II and select them in the Catastro parcel service (tested on BOPA núm. 299, Decreto 148/2014, 5 pages).
Where the annex only has a verbal description, locate the cadastral references in the Catastro WMS/parcel service.
if_unstructured.location_method: Coordinates in the annex of the declaration (UTM vertices, Ceuta example) when present; otherwise cadastral parcels listed in the annex (Asturias example), the attached plan (image page) or orthophoto.
cross_with: Ministry record code (R.I.-51-NNNNNNN) via Wikidata P808 and regional ids
Regional polygon layers for the same asset
Catastro parcel service and PNOA orthophoto for verification
